full.name: execute
full.description: Run model-authored JavaScript in this tedi's network-isolated JavaScript sandbox (Cloudflare WorkerLoader), with `state.*` wired to its durable DO-SQLite workspace (readFile/writeFile/glob/diff/replaceInFiles/applyEdits). No network. HIGH-risk producer gate: if the tedi's coding session isn't pre-authorized this PARKS and returns `requires_approval` + an `execution_id` (an approval card lands in the kernel ledger); once an operator approves, re-issue the same call and it runs inline, returning `{ executionId, result, logs? }`.

code.description: JavaScript async arrow function to run in this tedi's network-isolated JavaScript sandbox, e.g. `async () => { await state.writeFile({ path: '/out.txt', content: 'hi' }); return await state.readFile({ path: '/out.txt' }); }`. `state.*` is wired to the tedi's durable workspace; there is no network.

full.name: restart_skill_workflow
full.description: Restart a skill run from the beginning or a named execution-engine step occurrence. For an ambiguous pending/unknown receipt, an operator may set abortUnknown=true with a reason after verifying its reserved epoch never started; Tedix burns that exact epoch as a canceled submission/run without invoking the engine, retries must reuse the exact restartId/from/reason, and the retired engine instance cannot be restarted again—start a new runId.

confirmDestructive.description: Explicit confirmation for stateless MCP clients that cannot answer form elicitation

reason.description: Audit reason for the confirmed workflow restart; required when abortUnknown closes an ambiguous restart intent

restartId.description: Caller-stable idempotency key for this restart command; retry with the same value to repair partial API/ledger failures without invoking the engine again

abortUnknown.description: Operator recovery only: after verifying this pending/unknown reserved epoch never started, burn its exact submission/run projection as canceled and permanently retire that Workflow instance. Requires reason, never invokes the engine, exact retries must reuse restartId/from/reason, and subsequent work needs a new runId.

full.name: retire_unstarted_skill_workflow
full.description: Stop an old run whose accepted restart never began. Never starts or restarts the engine or invokes a model. Requires a terminal engine read, no reserved-epoch start/outcome evidence, exact original restartId/from and an audit reason. Permanently fences late starts. Repeat the same command only to finish an interrupted cancellation record.

confirmDestructive.description: Explicit confirmation for stateless MCP clients that cannot answer form elicitation

reason.description: Audit reason: stop this old run only, without restarting the engine or invoking a model.

full.name: repo_load

full.name: clone_repo

Pass exact paths when possible: oversized repositories replace repo/ with exactly the repo_load file set and return mode=repo_load_fallback, gitAvailable=false, snapshotIsolated=true. Use run_git only when gitAvailable=true; use open_computer for full checkout/Git CLI, installs, builds, or full validation.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit; defaults to the configured branch.

full.description: List this tedi's mailbox addresses ({slug}@tedix.tech, +tag aliases, custom domains) with status and routing policy. routingPolicy keys: allowedSenders = sender emails or @domain suffixes trusted only with a DKIM/DMARC pass; untrustedSenders = deliver (reply-only turn) | quarantine (stored as spam, no model) for everyone else; spamThreshold = spam score 0-20 (default 5) at or above which mail is quarantined.

full.name: create_tedi_email_address
full.description: Create a mailbox for this tedi: {slug}@tedix.tech or {slug}+tag@tedix.tech with an optional inbound routing policy. routingPolicy keys: allowedSenders = sender emails or @domain suffixes trusted only with a DKIM/DMARC pass; untrustedSenders = deliver (reply-only turn) | quarantine (stored as spam, no model) for everyone else; spamThreshold = spam score 0-20 (default 5) at or above which mail is quarantined.

address.description: Mailbox to create for this tedi: {slug}@tedix.tech (kind primary) or {slug}+tag@tedix.tech (kind plus) activate immediately; alias and custom_domain addresses are reserved until a platform admin provisions them.

allowedSenders.description: Trusted senders: full lowercase emails ("ceo@example.com") or @domain suffixes ("@example.com"). A match is trusted only when the message passed DKIM or DMARC for that domain. Replaces the whole list on update.

untrustedSenders.description: Disposition for senders not in allowedSenders: deliver runs a reply-only turn; quarantine stores the message as spam and never reaches the model.

spamThreshold.description: Spam score (0-20, default 5) at or above which inbound mail is quarantined regardless of sender.

source.description: Optional provenance label for who or what set this policy.

full.name: update_tedi_email_address
full.description: Update a mailbox's status (active, paused, reserved) and/or replace its inbound routing policy, e.g. to set a sender allowlist. routingPolicy keys: allowedSenders = sender emails or @domain suffixes trusted only with a DKIM/DMARC pass; untrustedSenders = deliver (reply-only turn) | quarantine (stored as spam, no model) for everyone else; spamThreshold = spam score 0-20 (default 5) at or above which mail is quarantined.

status.description: active receives mail; paused keeps the address and its threads but stops routing. Omit to leave the status unchanged.

allowedSenders.description: Trusted senders: full lowercase emails ("ceo@example.com") or @domain suffixes ("@example.com"). A match is trusted only when the message passed DKIM or DMARC for that domain. Replaces the whole list on update.

untrustedSenders.description: Disposition for senders not in allowedSenders: deliver runs a reply-only turn; quarantine stores the message as spam and never reaches the model.

spamThreshold.description: Spam score (0-20, default 5) at or above which inbound mail is quarantined regardless of sender.

source.description: Optional provenance label for who or what set this policy.

routingPolicy.description: Replaces the whole routing policy; null clears it (default routing). Omit to leave it unchanged.

full.name: retire_tedi_email_address
full.description: Retire a mailbox address so it stops receiving mail; stored threads and messages are kept. To pause instead, use update_tedi_email_address with status=paused.

full.name: report_dispatcher_health
full.description: Replace this organization's current sanitized health report for one local dispatcher lane.

full.name: list_dispatcher_health
full.description: List current local dispatcher lane health for this organization, including server report age and staleness.

full.name: work_items_list
full.description: List canonical Tedix Work Items for this tedi's organization.

disposition.description: Server-side lifecycle filter: proposed | accepted | completed | cancelled. There is no "status" field — "pending" work is disposition proposed (not yet accepted) or accepted (admitted, not completed).

accountableOwnerId.description: Server-side filter on the exact accountable owner identity (e.g. a tedi id), applied before paging so one owner's items are never hidden behind another owner's.

objectiveLinked.description: Server-side filter: true keeps only items linked to an objective, false only unlinked items.

customerVisibleOnly.description: Server-side PRE-FILTER that drops the dominant internal execution shapes (agent-session rows and transitional purpose contexts) before paging, so an embedded customer board is not paging through factory records to reach its own work. It is NOT the customer-visibility authority: the full rule has seven clauses and lives with the renderer, which must still apply it to what comes back.

full.name: work_item_get
full.description: Read one Work Item thread, including its bounded evidence ledger, comments, and external provider projections. Reviewers should use this exact read before deciding evidence.

full.name: get_work_graph_health
full.description: Deterministic coherence report over this org's Work Item/project graph. Read-only; each scan is windowed and `truncated` flags a cap hit.

full.name: run_work_graph_steward
full.description: Detect then (when `apply` is true) SAFELY repair the org work graph: link near-duplicate clusters, transition long-idle unclaimed items to `stale`, and leave `steward_flag` comments on naming/orphan findings. Never cancels a duplicate, deletes, or rewrites titles. `apply=false` (default) previews. Idempotent across re-runs.

confirmDestructive.description: Explicit confirmation for stateless MCP clients that cannot answer form elicitation

reason.description: Audited reason for running the destructive work-graph steward

full.name: get_org_graph_health
full.description: Blocked-work dependency analysis over this org's `blocks` graph — the planning-layer 'digital twin' read. Surfaces root blockers (chain heads ranked by transitive downstream impact, via a recursive CTE) with their owners, the blocker tedis holding up the most work (who to unblock first), and a best-effort capability-stall rollup by value-stream/pace-layer. Sibling of get_work_graph_health (coherence) but for dependency stalls. Read-only, org-scoped, cycle-safe, capped.

full.name: attach_work_item_source
full.description: Attach an external source (Notion page, Gmail thread, Drive file) to a project or Work Item as a source-graph edge. Stores IDENTITY only — provider, external id, url, title, and a caller-computed content hash — never the source content, so the connector stays the system of record. Idempotent: re-attaching an unchanged hash refreshes the freshness check, a moved hash flags the source changed, and a tombstoned source is revived.

full.name: list_work_item_sources
full.description: List the external sources attached to a project or Work Item, with a freshness report (counts by state, oldest check, never-checked). Tombstoned sources are excluded by default so a brief never renders a dead link.

full.name: reconcile_work_item_sources
full.description: Reconcile attached sources against what a sweep observed. Pass EVERY external id seen for the provider: anything attached and absent is marked missing, then tombstoned once it has stayed missing past the grace window. Absence means deletion, so never call this with a partial result set — skip the provider instead. Supports dryRun.

full.name: work_item_create
full.description: Create a provider-neutral Tedix Work Item from conversation, planning, or execution evidence. Purpose context is required: supply objectiveId, inherit it from projectId/parentWorkItemId, or supply maintenance/incident/hygiene workClass plus purposeExceptionExpiresAt no more than 30 days out.

factoryCycle.description: Derive proposed Work from an installed, pinned factory Blueprint. Same workspace/cycle key replays one Work Item; changed inputs conflict. Never grants execution authority.

factoryCard.description: The factory card this Work carries out (a run_skill Do it's cardSheetId and row). The server reads the card and its source and stores the card's decision envelope as metadata.decisionDeck.

objectiveId.description: Purpose, one of: this objective; a projectId or parentWorkItemId already linked to an objective; or workClass.

workClass.description: maintenance, incident or hygiene: the purpose when no objective applies; ignored when the project or parent has one. Defaults to maintenance in a projectId without an objective.

purposeExceptionExpiresAt.description: Expiry of an operational workClass: in the future and at most 30 days ahead. Defaults to 7 days.

startAt.description: Optional planned start for schedule views.

full.name: work_item_comment
full.description: Append human-readable discussion to a Work Item. Lifecycle state belongs to immutable events, attempts, and evidence.

full.name: get_work_item_readiness
full.description: Derive whether a Work Item is ready from disposition, dependencies, capabilities, authority, budget, resources, and live attempts.

full.name: start_work_attempt
full.description: Atomically start a fenced execution attempt for this tedi after readiness admission.

repository.description: Opt in to one isolated Cloudflare Artifacts repository for this Attempt.

expectedBaseRevision.description: Optional exact source commit fence; a changed source ref fails closed.

full.name: heartbeat_work_attempt
full.description: Heartbeat the exact active attempt fence; stale or expired attempts are rejected.

costMicros.description: Spend committed so far by this Attempt, in micros; replaces the running total on its budget reservation.

full.name: settle_work_attempt
full.description: Settle or durably park the exact fenced attempt without completing the Work Item outcome.

needsUser.description: Exact next click the requesting person must take. Creates one Needs-you ask atomically with settlement when the click names an owner-only act (money, legal or tax, consent or credentials, access, deletion, publishing or messaging); any other next step is filed with the Work's agent steward or this lane instead. Does not complete the Work.

requestId.description: Original private request-ledger row, when known. Must belong to the requesting user and this Work's project.

repositoryLifecycle.description: Secret-free review, canonical GitHub main merge, and live deployment receipt for an Artifacts-backed Attempt.

costMicros.description: Spend committed by this Attempt, in micros. The budget reservation consumes exactly this amount; Omitted, the running total reported by heartbeats is used; with none, a succeeded/failed Attempt consumes its full reservation and a cancelled/expired one releases it.

full.name: list_work_attempts
full.description: List immutable execution attempts for one Work Item.

cursor.description: Opaque attempt-ledger cursor; omit to read the newest bounded page.

full.name: submit_work_evidence
full.description: Submit typed evidence from the exact active attempt against one acceptance claim.

full.name: complete_work_item
full.description: Complete an accepted Work Item once its Attempt has settled. Settled means done: no evidence count or review stands in front of completion.

full.name: list_work_evidence
full.description: List evidence and verifier dispositions for one Work Item.

cursor.description: Opaque evidence-ledger cursor; omit to read the newest bounded page.

full.name: list_work_events
full.description: Read the append-only Work Item lifecycle event stream.

full.name: work_item_corroborate
full.description: Corroborate an existing Work Item with an independently observed source reference.

body.description: How you independently reproduced/hit this. Defaults to a generic corroboration note.

evidenceRef.description: Required commit, artifact, or reproduction evidence ref.

full.name: work_item_add_relation
full.description: Relate two Work Items as blockers, duplicates, or references.

full.name: work_item_upsert_projection
full.description: Attach or update an external task/project-management provider reference for a Work Item.

full.name: harness_versions
full.description: List this tedi's harness versions, optionally filtered by promotion status or runtime kind.

full.name: harness_trace_bundle
full.description: List this tedi's trace bundles by run id or harness version for replay and certification evidence.

full.name: harness_eval_runs
full.description: List grouped harness eval runs for this tedi and harness version.

full.name: harness_compare
full.description: Compare a candidate harness version against the active version or an explicit base version.

full.name: harness_promote
full.description: Advance a harness version through the eval-gated promotion ladder.

full.name: read_home_messages
full.description: Read the tenant Home transcript for plan, approval, and async delegation proof.

full.name: read_home_run_set
full.description: Read Home's durable run set, including plan metadata, delegated child links, progress, and active run ids.

summary.description: Compact projection for agent context budgets: omits per-run metadata bags and the approvalMirrors rendering projection; identity, status, timing, progress, and usage survive.

full.name: read_home_run
full.description: Inspect one parent Home run by runId: status, typed route, child-run links, progress, and evidence.

full.name: approve_home_plan
full.description: Approve proposed Home plan assignments, promote them into Work Items, and optionally dispatch delegated child runs.

full.name: respond_home_approval
full.description: Approve or reject what a Home run is waiting on: write-action cards, delegation approvals, workstation attachments, and proposed plans.

full.name: cancel_home_run
full.description: Stop a parent Home run and its delegated children by runId without ending the conversation. The authenticated user may stop their own run without another approval.

full.name: steer_home_run
full.description: Attach an operator steering instruction to an active parent Home run or work card.

full.name: retry_delegation
full.description: Recover a proof-gate BLOCKED delegation Work Item: operator-gated re-dispatch, bounded by MAX_DELEGATION_RETRIES.

full.name: sweep_delegation_autonomy
full.description: Release pending Home delegation holds only when the current organization autonomy policy independently allows them. Does not supply a human approval. Carry nextCursor until null.

excludeReferences.description: Literal resource or run references that must remain held.

full.name: create_work_item
full.description: Track a NEW provider-neutral organization Work Item from the operator/Home surface without borrowing a tedi identity. Purpose context is required: supply objectiveId, inherit it from projectId/parentWorkItemId, or supply maintenance/incident/hygiene workClass plus purposeExceptionExpiresAt no more than 30 days out. The caller's org is resolved from the request; an optional assigneeTediId is org-checked.

factoryCycle.description: Derive proposed Work from an installed, pinned factory Blueprint. Same workspace/cycle key replays one Work Item; changed inputs conflict. Never grants execution authority.

factoryCard.description: The factory card this Work carries out (a run_skill Do it's cardSheetId and row). The server reads the card and its source and stores the card's decision envelope as metadata.decisionDeck.

objectiveId.description: Purpose, one of: this objective; a projectId or parentWorkItemId already linked to an objective; or workClass.

workClass.description: maintenance, incident or hygiene: the purpose when no objective applies; ignored when the project or parent has one. Defaults to maintenance in a projectId without an objective.

purposeExceptionExpiresAt.description: Expiry of an operational workClass: in the future and at most 30 days ahead. Defaults to 7 days.

startAt.description: Optional planned start for schedule views.

full.name: update_work_item
full.description: Update descriptive Work Item specification fields. Set executor to codex or claude-code on accepted Work to start a fresh local session with the description as its brief. Disposition, readiness, attempts, and evidence use their dedicated lifecycle operations.

idleReassignment.description: Owner/admin dispatcher reassignment. Preserves the Work revision and failure hold; cannot accompany specification edits.

executor.description: codex or claude-code on accepted Work queues a fresh session that a connected Mac starts and that claims its own Attempt. Owners, admins and the Work's tedi steward may set it.

projectId.description: Owner/admin move to another project in this organization. Objective Work takes the new project's objective; Work linked to a milestone must be detached first.

expectedWorkItemVersion.description: Optional exact-version fence; omitted updates retain their server-side compare-and-swap behavior.

workClass.description: Owner/admin purpose repair. Choose objective to use the project's objective and clear the exception expiry; other existing classes cannot change.

purposeExceptionExpiresAt.description: Owner/admin renewal of operational purpose, bounded to 30 days.

startAt.description: Omit to preserve the planned start; null clears it.

durationDays.description: Omit to preserve duration; null clears it.

addEvidenceKinds.description: Additional evidence kinds per acceptance claim key. Additive only: existing kinds are always retained, so evidence already submitted stays valid.

full.name: cancel_work_item
full.description: Cancel a single organization Work Item specification. Existing attempt and evidence history remains immutable.

hygiene.description: Atomically preserve recent human comments and, for idle cleanup, any Attempt history.

full.name: payments_list_accounts
full.description: List TedixPay payment accounts scoped to this tedi.

full.name: payments_list_reservations
full.description: List TedixPay/x402 reservations scoped to this tedi.

collaboration.name: ask
collaboration.description: Send a message to this tedi's main agent session.

message.description: Message to send to the tedi's main agent session.

collaboration.name: execute
collaboration.description: Run model-authored JavaScript in this tedi's network-isolated JavaScript sandbox (Cloudflare WorkerLoader), with `state.*` wired to its durable DO-SQLite workspace (readFile/writeFile/glob/diff/replaceInFiles/applyEdits). No network. HIGH-risk producer gate: if the tedi's coding session isn't pre-authorized this PARKS and returns `requires_approval` + an `execution_id` (an approval card lands in the kernel ledger); once an operator approves, re-issue the same call and it runs inline, returning `{ executionId, result, logs? }`.

code.description: JavaScript async arrow function to run in this tedi's network-isolated JavaScript sandbox, e.g. `async () => { await state.writeFile({ path: '/out.txt', content: 'hi' }); return await state.readFile({ path: '/out.txt' }); }`. `state.*` is wired to the tedi's durable workspace; there is no network.

collaboration.name: conversations_list
collaboration.description: List this tedi's cognitive-runtime conversations and agent sessions.

collaboration.name: messages_read
collaboration.description: Read recent messages from one of this tedi's sessions.

collaboration.name: synthesize_spoken_reply
collaboration.description: Synthesize this tedi's assistant text into a real speech audio attachment payload. Use this for voice-message validation instead of beep or tone fixtures.

text.description: Assistant text to synthesize into a real spoken audio reply.

collaboration.name: record_learning_interaction
collaboration.description: Record an idempotent accepted, edited, ignored, rejected, retried, undone, manually replaced, or completed-elsewhere product interaction for this tedi.

collaboration.name: list_learning_interactions
collaboration.description: List this tedi's scoped product-interaction learning signals by kind, issue, scope, or time window.

collaboration.name: attribute_learning_feedback
collaboration.description: Link learning interaction events to a proposed, evaluated, promoted, rejected, or rolled-back memory, directive, skill, harness, or workflow change.

collaboration.name: record_learning_measurement
collaboration.description: Record an idempotent baseline or follow-up opportunity/recurrence measurement for an attributed learning change.

collaboration.name: get_learning_feedback_summary
collaboration.description: Read attributed feedback and compare baseline versus follow-up recurrence rates for a learning change.

collaboration.name: analyze_recurring_learning_issues
collaboration.description: Group this tedi's repeated negative interaction signals into evidence-linked improvement candidates; three distinct occurrences are required by default.

collaboration.name: propose_learning_improvement
collaboration.description: Create an idempotent governed improvement proposal from at least three recurring negative evidence events. This never promotes the target subject.

collaboration.name: list_learning_improvements
collaboration.description: Read this tedi's governed learning proposals, pinned measurement pair, and human handoff disposition.

collaboration.name: evaluate_learning_improvement
collaboration.description: Evaluate a proposal against exact baseline/follow-up measurements from one attributed, chronological cohort. Only measured improvement becomes ready for human handoff review; downstream certification remains mandatory.

collaboration.name: record_entity_mention
collaboration.description: Record one immutable entity mention: surface form, normalized form, proposed type, confidence, extractor identity, and the source uri/hash it came from. Extraction evidence only — recording a mention never links it to an entity, which requires a separately reviewed resolution decision.

collaboration.name: memory_search
collaboration.description: Search this tedi's memory facts.

collaboration.name: memory_health
collaboration.description: Inspect this tedi's memory system health.

collaboration.name: review_memory_fact
collaboration.description: Review, reject, supersede, or archive one of this tedi org's memory facts through the canonical lifecycle fields.

archived.description: Set true to soft-archive the fact, false to unarchive it.

collaboration.name: get_rationale_chain
collaboration.description: Read this tedi's rationale chain.

limit.description: Maximum rationale records to return (default: 20, max: 100).

collaboration.widgetDescription: Recent rationale records for this tedi, including category, confidence, and outcomes.

collaboration.name: get_tedi_runtime_status
collaboration.description: Read canonical Tedix runtime status for this tedi, independent of runtime implementation.

skills.name: record_artifact
skills.description: Publish an openable, tedi-owned artifact with an optional inline body. Ownership is injected from this tedi namespace.

accessClassification.description: Immutable byte-access classification; runtime_private is never a bearer capability

path.description: Bundle-relative path, e.g. index.html or js/app.js

skills.name: propose_skill_workflow_improvement
skills.description: Create a validated draft revision of a skill's automation (its scripts/workflow.ts file), grounded in an observed finished run. The tedi may test it but cannot activate it.

skills.name: inspect_skill_workflow_improvement
skills.description: Inspect a proposed automation improvement: where it came from, its validation, baseline drift, and what activation requires.

skills.name: activate_skill_workflow_improvement
skills.description: Activate an automation revision after a completed candidate run of this proposal reports passing correctness certification and the baseline is unchanged.

skills.name: propose_skill
skills.description: Create a tedi-scoped Skill Workshop proposal. Stored as draft until applied.

title.description: Skill title. Optional when template is factory-lane.

slug.description: Explicit canonical skill slug. When omitted, the slug is minted from title.

template.description: Render a versioned Tedix-owned factory lane skill.

name.description: Stable step name used in the durable workflow ledger

tool.description: Platform-reviewed read-only tedi tool called by this gather step

folderPath.description: Optional catalog folder path. This is organizational metadata and never changes the skill slug or skill:// URI.

sourceSkillId.description: Lineage: canonical skill this entry is derived/copied from (cross-org copies should stamp this so fleet drift is enumerable)

sourceRevision.description: Lineage: the source skill's revision at copy time

content.description: Full procedure markdown. Optional when template is factory-lane.

files.description: Supporting files (path → content) for folder-style skills

appSlug.description: Human-friendly app slug — used to resolve appId for toolSlugs scope

toolSlugs.description: Human-friendly tool slugs (matches app_tools.tool_id). Resolved server-side to UUIDs and merged with toolIds. Requires appId or appSlug for resolution scope.

validate.description: Validation gate: error throws on issues, warn logs and proceeds, skip bypasses validation

force.description: Bypass the near-duplicate gate. Creation is refused when an existing skill has an equivalent title — prefer improve_skills. Set force only for a genuinely distinct procedure.

workspaceId.description: The Workspace this skill runs for, such as the Workspace of the current conversation. The new skill is linked to it, so the Workspace's Resources list the skill with its schedule and runs

skills.name: mine_skill_candidates
skills.description: Deterministically mine recurring successful tool-call routines from evidence-linked episodes into draft Skill Workshop proposals (never auto-applied).

minSupport.description: Minimum DISTINCT successful runs a routine must recur in (floor 3)

maxProposals.description: Cap on Skill Workshop proposals created per run (default 3)

dryRun.description: Mine and report patterns without creating proposals

skills.name: get_skill_portfolio_balance
skills.description: Pace-layer distribution of the skill portfolio (innovation/differentiation/record) vs the ~75/20/5 healthy envelope, with a mechanical stagnation flag (all-innovation or all-record). Org-wide.

skills.name: inspect_skill_proposal
skills.description: Inspect a Skill Workshop proposal without mutation, including validation and promotion blockers.

skills.name: revise_skill_proposal
skills.description: Revise a pending Skill Workshop proposal in place while keeping it draft.

tediId.description: Attach an owning tedi to a tedi-less skill (required before the skill can own a native schedule). ATTACH-ONLY: changing an existing owner is rejected — ownership transfer is an authority change and needs a deliberate surface, not an edit field.

slug.description: Immutable canonical SEP-2640 slug. It may be repeated unchanged by older clients, but renaming is rejected; use skills.move for catalog organization.

files.description: Supporting files (path → content) for folder-style skills. Full overwrite — caller sends the entire desired files map.

appSlug.description: Human-friendly app slug — used to resolve appId for toolSlugs scope

toolSlugs.description: Human-friendly tool slugs (matches app_tools.tool_id). Resolved server-side to UUIDs and merged with toolIds. Requires appId or appSlug for resolution scope.

paceLayer.description: Manual pace-layer override. Auto-derived from lifecycle otherwise; requires force: true and human/operator authority, and is re-derived on the next lifecycle transition.

force.description: Human/operator override for execute-to-promote lifecycle gating. Requires user or API-key auth; rejected for agent-authenticated callers.

validate.description: Validation gate: error throws on issues, warn logs and proceeds, skip bypasses validation

skills.name: apply_skill_proposal
skills.description: Disposer-separated: apply a general Skill Workshop proposal into the baseline org skill library. Passes for a human/operator API key, or for a tedi that is NOT the proposal's authoring identity; self-approval by the proposer is mechanically rejected.

lifecycleState.description: Target lifecycle state. Defaults to active, while preserving proven/crystallized proposals.

revisionReasoning.description: Reason this proposal is accepted into the org library

failureModes.description: Premortem (Klein 2007): assume this promoted skill failed in 30 days — list at least two distinct ways it failed

rollback.description: How this promotion is rolled back when a failure mode fires

skipPremortemReason.description: Operator-only premortem waiver (signed-in human or operator API key), logged into revisionReasoning; agent callers cannot skip

skills.name: reject_skill_proposal
skills.description: Reject a Skill Workshop proposal and archive it with an explicit reason.

skills.name: quarantine_skill_proposal
skills.description: Quarantine a risky Skill Workshop proposal by marking it stale with an explicit reason.

skills.name: validate_skill
skills.description: Validate an existing or draft skill without mutating stored skills.

toolSlugs.description: App tool slugs. SKILL.md metadata.io.modelcontextprotocol/tools is also parsed.

skills.name: preview_skill
skills.description: Preview rendered skill metadata, URI, index entry, and diagnostics without writing.

toolSlugs.description: App tool slugs. SKILL.md metadata.io.modelcontextprotocol/tools is also parsed.

skills.name: audit_skill_tool_coverage
skills.description: Audit whether skills cover app tools, MCP tool metadata resolves, and read-only tools have outputSchema.

skills.name: audit_low_quality_skills
skills.description: Audit low-quality or auto-crystallized skills. Defaults to this tedi's tedi-scoped working set; archive mode requires explicit input.

ownership.description: Which ownership tier to audit. Baseline means tediId is null; tedi-scoped means tediId is set.

slug.description: Optional exact skill slug for targeted review.

maxSuccessCount.description: Maximum successful uses for the unproven-active rule.

minSlugLength.description: Minimum slug length for the sentence-slug rule.

orphanOlderThanDays.description: Age threshold for never-used orphan skills.

archive.description: Archive matched candidates. Requires slug or confirmBulkArchive.

confirmBulkArchive.description: Required for archive=true without an exact slug.

skills.name: repair_skill
skills.description: Repair one stored skill. Defaults to dryRun=true for non-mutating diagnostics.

skills.name: promote_skill
skills.description: Human-only when applying: promote a tedi-scoped candidate into the baseline org skill library. Defaults to dryRun=true.

lifecycleState.description: Target lifecycle state. Defaults to active, while preserving proven/crystallized candidates.

supersedesId.description: Optional baseline skill id that this promotion supersedes

revisionReasoning.description: Reason this candidate is accepted into the org library

force.description: Human/operator override for execute-to-promote lifecycle gating. Requires user or API-key auth; rejected for agent-authenticated callers.

failureModes.description: Premortem (Klein 2007): assume this promoted skill failed in 30 days — list at least two distinct ways it failed

rollback.description: How this promotion is rolled back when a failure mode fires

skipPremortemReason.description: Operator-only premortem waiver (signed-in human or operator API key), logged into revisionReasoning; agent callers cannot skip

skills.name: list_promotion_candidates
skills.description: List tedi-scoped skill candidates for org-library promotion review.

minSuccessCount.description: Minimum successful uses required for candidacy.

skills.name: run_skill_workflow
skills.description: Start the automation (scripts/workflow.ts) attached to one of this tedi's skills.

confirmDestructive.description: Explicit confirmation for stateless MCP clients that cannot answer form elicitation

reason.description: Audit reason for the confirmed workflow dispatch

certification.description: Owner/admin-only certification run; allows the pinned draft revision's declared manifest calls

runId.description: Caller-supplied stable run id for safely retrying a dispatch. When both fields are supplied, runId is the explicit workflow identity and idempotencyKey is retained as audit context.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable caller key forwarded to the runtime for idempotent admission. When runId is absent, the runtime derives an opaque identity from organization, skill, tedi, and this key.

expectedSkillRevision.description: Reject dispatch when the selected skill revision differs from the reviewed revision

skillId.description: Skill UUID — provide either skillId or slug

skills.description: Read status, output, and error information for a skill run.

items.label: Published deliverable
items.description: Filled in when the run published its result.

items.label: What went wrong

offset.description: Number of persisted history rows to skip

reconcile.description: Set false for a strictly read-only snapshot of persisted run history; no workflow engine reconciliation or repair is attempted.

skills.name: list_skill_workflow_retry_candidates
skills.description: List failed automation runs whose canonical engine state was reconciled and is eligible for an epoch-bound restart. Use this inbox instead of inferring retries from generic history.

skills.name: list_org_skills
skills.description: List ALL of this organization's skills — including org-scoped rows (tediId null) that list_skills cannot see. Built for automation-sandbox analytics: the flow-ephemeral adoption cohort is org-scoped, so it is countable only through this org-wide lens. Pass summary:true for compact rows (content becomes a marked preview, files null) and filter tags client-side.

query.description: Optional title, slug, description, or folder-path search

folderPath.description: Filter by catalog folder. Null selects the root; omit to search all folders.

recursive.description: Include descendant folders when folderPath is set

excludeImprovements.description: Exclude workflow improvement copies before counting and paginating

improvementsOf.description: Only workflow improvements of this canonical skill

excludeArchived.description: Exclude archived skills before counting and paginating

summary.description: Compact projection for agent context budgets: truncates `content` to a short preview (marked with a read_skill pointer) and nulls `files`. Use read_skill for the full SKILL.md once you know which skill you need.

rollback.description: Run registered Cloudflare Workflow rollback handlers before termination

skills.name: pause_skill_workflow

skills.name: resume_skill_workflow
skills.description: Resume a paused skill run.

skills.name: restart_skill_workflow
skills.description: Restart a skill run from the beginning or a named execution-engine step occurrence. For an ambiguous pending/unknown receipt, an operator may set abortUnknown=true with a reason after verifying its reserved epoch never started; Tedix burns that exact epoch as a canceled submission/run without invoking the engine, retries must reuse the exact restartId/from/reason, and the retired engine instance cannot be restarted again—start a new runId.

confirmDestructive.description: Explicit confirmation for stateless MCP clients that cannot answer form elicitation

reason.description: Audit reason for the confirmed workflow restart; required when abortUnknown closes an ambiguous restart intent

restartId.description: Caller-stable idempotency key for this restart command; retry with the same value to repair partial API/ledger failures without invoking the engine again

abortUnknown.description: Operator recovery only: after verifying this pending/unknown reserved epoch never started, burn its exact submission/run projection as canceled and permanently retire that Workflow instance. Requires reason, never invokes the engine, exact retries must reuse restartId/from/reason, and subsequent work needs a new runId.

skills.name: retire_unstarted_skill_workflow
skills.description: Stop an old run whose accepted restart never began. Never starts or restarts the engine or invokes a model. Requires a terminal engine read, no reserved-epoch start/outcome evidence, exact original restartId/from and an audit reason. Permanently fences late starts. Repeat the same command only to finish an interrupted cancellation record.

confirmDestructive.description: Explicit confirmation for stateless MCP clients that cannot answer form elicitation

reason.description: Audit reason: stop this old run only, without restarting the engine or invoking a model.
